bullets.text: In Chennai, a youth died after inhaling toxic gas while trying to rescue a worker who fell into a sewage tank in Pallikaranai.
The State Wetlands Authority told the Madras High Court that the interim zone of influence around Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers.
In Chennai, political parties raised questions in Pallikaranai regarding the construction of a retaining wall and walkway inside the wetland.
In Chennai, PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss questioned the purpose of building a 21.5 crore rupee compound wall in the Pallikaranai marshland.
In Chennai, Shri Physio and Rehab Centre in Adyar will conduct an osteoporosis awareness and detection camp on October 20 for World Osteoporosis Day.
In Ambattur, a man stabbed his own brother to death following a dispute over alleged sexual harassment of a relative's child.
In Chennai, the new Phase II metro stretch from Poonamallee to Vadapalani recorded 25,474 passengers on its first day of operations.
In Avadi, the city police commissioner reported that six people were arrested for manufacturing fake bank cheques, documents, and educational certificates.
IIT Madras Pravartak partnered with Medhastra Techsystems to develop indigenous artificial intelligence for defense applications.
HCLTech signed a global partnership with Anthropic to expand enterprise agentic AI deployment with a focus on safety and governance.
MeitY showcased digital public infrastructure, language AI, and semiconductor initiatives at its pavilion during the IMC 2026 event.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss criticized the DMK and TVK parties in Chennai regarding ongoing controversies surrounding the Pallikaranai marshland.
DMK Parliamentary leader Kanimozhi wrote a letter to the Union Minister complaining about the removal of political criticism posts against TVK on Instagram.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss raised issues in Chennai concerning residents who are unable to obtain pattas for their ancestral lands.
Prime Minister Modi visited Chennai to inaugurate development projects worth 13,000 crore rupees, including the new metro rail stretch.
